license_note: The official IBM model card and the IBM Granite release materials identify Apache 2.0 as the license for the published Granite-4.0-H-Micro repository and checkpoint, mirroring the reviewed Granite-4.0-H-Small record. The repository carries the license identifier in its pinned model card rather than a separate license file.

license_evidence.scope: Official granite-4.0-h-micro model repository, Safetensors checkpoint, tokenizer, and chat template

access_boundary: This record represents the ibm-granite/granite-4.0-h-micro instruct release dated October 2, 2025. The Granite-4.0-H-Micro-Base model, the Tiny, Small, and 8B variants, quantizations, IBM watsonx.ai services, and independent hosts are separate boundaries.
strengths: IBM publishes ungated signed Safetensors shards under an OSI-approved Apache-2.0 grant
Serving is documented through watsonx.ai and several independent distribution and hosting paths
tradeoffs: The license statement is carried in model-card metadata instead of a repository license file
The hybrid GQA-Mamba2 architecture is documented only through the Transformers path, so other runtimes need independent verification
